credits.title: Sessiz Yalanlar
credits.overview: Ceren, who believes she is the wife of renowned architect Murat Özgenç, is undergoing treatment at a mental hospital. However, she cannot convince the doctors of her husband's identity. Ceren refuses to take her medication and decides to deceive the doctors and escape from the hospital.
